item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Near-instant provisioning for Azure DocumentDB clusters
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports near-instant provisioning for M10 through M30 compute tiers. This extends the earlier instant-provisioning capability that was previously limited to the free tier.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB is now generally available as a fully managed, cloud-native PostgreSQL service for high-performance, AI-driven, and large-scale workloads. It is positioned for use cases needing ultra-low latency, high scalability, and reliability.

  • Source: Azure Updates
